node.statement: Finite-induction rule: for any integer q >= 1 and propositions P(1),...,P(q), the conjunction of P(1) and the implications P(k) => P(k+1) for every integer 1 <= k < q implies P(q). This follows by ordinary induction on k (with the q=1 case ending at the base case).
